items.title: Niche Perfumery Boutique
items.description: L'Odore is a luxury niche perfume boutique and fragrance brand known for curating artisanal, high-end scents tailored to refined Eastern and Middle Eastern tastes. Displayed like an art gallery, their collections feature distinguished niche fragrance brands.
